strategies.name: RSI Reversion
strategies.description: Bets that a sharp drop or spike on the 1-minute chart will snap back. It goes long when RSI falls to the oversold level and short when RSI rises to the overbought level. Every entry comes with its own stop-loss and take-profit, which Alpaca manages.

strategies.name: TJR Liquidity Sweep
strategies.description: A rule-based version of the popular liquidity sweep and fair value gap style. Traders say stop-losses pile up just beyond obvious highs and lows, and that price often runs those levels and then reverses. The bot waits for price to run the previous day's high or low (or a high or low from earlier today) and snap back, for the 5-minute chart to shift structure the other way, and for price to pull back into a gap on the 1-minute chart. Then it trades in the new direction with the stop beyond the sweep. The whole account goes into one position at a time, and each trade is closed within the hour. This is an automated approximation of a style that is normally traded by eye, so the results say whether this version works, not the whole idea.

strategies.name: EMA + VWAP Trend
strategies.description: A trend-following strategy. When a stock is trending (price on the right side of the day's VWAP and a fast moving average pulled away from a slow one), the bot waits for the first dip against the trend, buys it in an uptrend or sells it in a downtrend, and rides the move with a stop beyond the dip. It is the opposite of RSI Reversion: that one bets on snap-backs, this one bets that strong moves keep going. The whole account goes into one position at a time and everything is closed before the market closes.
